prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, progressive character/scene edit.
Input image is APPROVED RANK 1 of a pixel-art growing apothecary world. Create RANK 2, a modest meaningful evolution: the black cat has begun actually making medicine rather than playing. One same tall portrait 9:19.5 illustration.
Preserve this cat's identity: natural small feline head, black fur with subdued blue-violet shadows and selective amber light, restrained tiny eye, no sharp mascot outlines. Match the EXACT pixel-painted material and irregular clustered pixel texture of cat, mortar and ground. Not smooth anime, plush toy or cartoon human.
RANK2 ACTION: Cat sits naturally on hindquarters on stone ground, full tail visible curling aside. It has learned a slightly upright purposeful posture, wearing ONLY a tiny simple rough tan linen bib APRON over normal black cat body, no shirt/pants/hat/human shoes. Both FRONT PAWS now brace a single stone pestle from opposite sides and carefully press/grind crushed medicinal leaves INSIDE the ceramic mortar. Paw-sized rounded feline paws, no human fingers, no disconnected limbs, exactly two front legs and two hind legs with coherent anatomy. Lower pestle end clearly seated inside bowl. Head lowered with earnest absorbed concentration. Same quiet natural animal presence but unmistakably a novice pharmacist.
Only a few supporting additions: ONE small corked glass medicine bottle containing a muted pale green liquid on ground beside mortar, a small piece of brown paper with a sprig of herbs, and one simple clay herb pot beside wall. No built pharmacy, workbench, shelves or equipment.
COMPOSITION: Pull camera back SLIGHTLY relative to reference so cat's entire body and small work area fit comfortably, whole group around middle-lower half, more room around tail than rank1, mortar foreground-right of cat and bottle beside it. The cat becomes about 22-26% total picture height rather than a large close-up; do not lose intimate focus.
SCENERY JUST BEGINNING: Extend visible stone paving island a little beyond rank1. Immediately behind cat introduce ONLY a small low section of weathered pale plaster wall with a few exposed base stones, a low stone step receding a short distance, and the single medicinal herb pot. Subtle suggestion of coastal alley corner, NOT full street, doors, houses, town, sky or horizon. Scenic fragments should occupy only a small area around cat and fade organically into blank field within the lower two-thirds. Highest upper third or more remains empty creamy parchment color. All outer margins still broad soft ivory/pale yellow sheep-parchment haze like source (#eee2bc to #f4e9cc), opaque not transparent, softly feathered irregular boundaries, no rectangular mask or hard circle. Background fragments low contrast and diffuse toward margins, main cat/mortar softly crisp pixel-painted, no whole-picture blur. Keep warm muted lamp-like highlights with no visible lamp needed, cool grey-violet paving core gently blended into cream.
No clutter, no fully developed architecture, no giant magic glow, readable writing, UI, labels, title, numeral, border or watermark. One still concept, not animation frames/sprite sheet or diagram.
